import sqlite3
import stripe
import requests

BILLING_EVENTS_URL = 'http://billing-events.internal/api/v1/sponsorship-charges'

def sponsor_job_posting(posting_id, fee_cents, customer_id):
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=fee_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, metadata={'posting_id': str(posting_id)})
    # Notify the internal billing ledger service about the sponsorship charge
    requests.post(
        BILLING_EVENTS_URL,
        json={
            'posting_id': posting_id,
            'customer_id': customer_id,
            'amount_cents': fee_cents,
            'payment_intent': intent.id,
            'status': intent.status,
        },
        timeout=5,
    )
    with sqlite3.connect('recruiting.db') as conn:
        conn.execute('INSERT INTO sponsored_postings SELECT * FROM postings WHERE id = ?', (posting_id,))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM postings WHERE id = ?', (posting_id,))
    return {'posting_id': posting_id, 'payment_intent': intent.id, 'status': intent.status}
